items.contentSnippet: See how an MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex to autonomously run quantum computing experiments, analyze results, and calibrate qubits.

summaries.en: An MIT researcher uses GPT-5.6 Sol, paired with Codex, to autonomously operate quantum computing experiments. The AI assists in running the experiments, analyzing the results, and calibrating qubits, streamlining tasks that typically require manual intervention. This demonstrates a practical application of advanced AI in quantum research, improving efficiency in handling complex experimental procedures.

summaries.en: Coding agents are significantly reshaping AI research inside OpenAI, according to early internal data highlighted in the article. The findings indicate that AI coding agents have become an integral part of OpenAI's research workflow, enabling faster iteration, more complex task handling, and accelerated progress in research efforts. The data underscores a transformative shift in how research is conducted at the organization.

items.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
items.content: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.

The announcement underscores a focused investment in safeguarding services that are vital to daily operations.

items.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
items.content: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.
items.contentSnippet: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.

summaries.zh: ATV Big Air Tour 利用 ChatGPT Work 加速其营销和商品管理等工作流程，将原本需要 3 天完成的任务缩短至 3 小时。此外，该团队还借助此工具，在 15 分钟内将商品照片转化为一个库存网站。这体现了 AI 工具在提升运营效率方面的实际应用。
summaries.en: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to significantly speed up its business operations. The company reports that tasks which previously took three days can now be completed in just three hours. ChatGPT is used to accelerate marketing and merchandising efforts. For example, merchandise photos were turned into a functional inventory website in only 15 minutes. This demonstrates how the company leverages the AI tool to streamline workflows and improve efficiency across multiple parts of its operations.
